title: Benchmark machine profile
responsibility: Captures machine and runtime facts and derives a repeatable profile identity for measurement comparison.

outputs.name: machineProfile
outputs.description: Returns the current host platform, architecture, first CPU model, processor entry count, total memory in bytes, runtime version, and a derived id for grouping measurements by machine profile. The id is the first 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over JSON.stringify of those facts; CPU falls back to "unknown" and processor count to 1 for an empty CPU list, while a trimmed nonblank HARNESS_PROFILE_LABEL is appended to runtime to separate otherwise indistinguishable runner classes and cannot make differing machine facts match.
